svg.text: Block | What it is and why it's there | Source
**Title** | The page's specific `<title>` text, concise and descriptive. | Google & Our Structure
**Main Heading** | One distinct visible heading (e.g., `<h1>`) summarizing the page. | Google & Our Structure
**Direct Answer** | The first sentence in the body, giving the reader the most trusted information. | Our Structure
**Sections** | Organized content under headings, making the page easy to follow. | Google & Our Structure
**Lists** | Visible sequences within sections, used for ordered facts. | Our Structure
**Tables** | Visible comparisons within sections, used for comparing facts. | Our Structure
**Images** | Pictures with descriptive alt text, placed near the text they explain. | Google & Our Structure
**Internal Link** | Crawlable links to other pages on our site, with clear anchor text. | Google & Our Structure
**External Link** | Crawlable links to external sources, citing our facts. | Google & Our Structure

**Canonical URL** | An [absolute `rel="canonical"` in the head, pointing](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/consolidate-duplicate-urls) to this page's URL. | Google & Our Structure
**Published Date** | [A visible, labeled date](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/creating-helpful-content) showing when the page first went live. | Google & Our Structure
**Modified Date** | [A visible, labeled date for](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/publication-dates) significant updates to the content. | Google & Our Structure
**Byline** | The name of the author or organization, where a reader would expect it. | Google & Our Structure
**Automation Disclosure** | A brief note on how automation was used, if a reader might ask. | Google & Our Structure
**Call to Action** | An optional link to close the page, not essential for the page's value. | Our Structure
